Short form уверен / уверена. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'веренный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('confident, sure').
